author: Tony1320
notes_extra: Virgin Lapua Palma brass. Seated 0.015 off the lands. Neck tension 0.002. He tested from 43.0 to 44.0 and chose 43.8. No velocity. He did not name the cartridge; the brass is Palma.

author: T-shooter
notes_extra: Stock Savage chamber. He had not finalized the load. The 200.20x liked 0.005 off to just touching. Average groups about 1/2 MOA for 5 shots. A later lot of the same cases was 7 percent larger.

author: T-shooter
notes_extra: Stock Savage .308 chamber. He had not finished working the load up. Best grouping seemed to be a zero to 0.005 jump.

author: T-shooter
notes_extra: Same rifle as the 43.5 gr row. He said it seemed to group better at 43.3 g. No velocity for this charge.

author: creedfan
notes_extra: 0.020 off. 30 in 5R barrel. He wrote 200 20x. The original post names the rifle as .308.

author: BP1
notes_extra: 12 thousandths off. 4-groove Krieger. He wrote 200 20x. The original post names the rifle as .308.

author: BP1
notes_extra: Same seating, 12 thousandths off, 4-groove Krieger 30 in. He wrote 20x.

author: Stingray
notes_extra: 20 thousandths off. He wrote 20x. The same post uses 43.8 gr Varget 13 thousandths off for 215 Berger Hybrids, which is a different bullet. The original post names the rifle as .308.

author: JayBeeYou
notes_extra: He is at 44.2 inside a stated window of 43.9 to 44.4. 0.015 jump. 170 freebore. SRP brass, and he said Lapua is the most popular. The thread is a .308.

author: Ned Ludd
notes_extra: Several 30 in 5R Bartlein 10- and 11-twist barrels, 0.180 freebore. Seated 0.012 off. He wrote COAL about 3.109 to 3.115. H4895 was comparable in a tuned load but he gave no H4895 charge.

author: D-4297
notes_extra: Low node. Kelby Panda, 30 in Brux 1/10 twist. He suggested 0.180 freebore and seating from 0.005 to 0.020 off.

author: D-4297
notes_extra: High node, seated to touch. Kelby Panda, 30 in Brux 1-10. He called this the 2017 load. The Jan 21, 2021 post already listed 44.2 gr at an average of 2668 fps.

author: Ilya S.
notes_extra: 0.010 off. True Flite 32 in 10-twist 4-groove heavy Palma tube. +2 C. Groups about 1 MOA, no pressure signs. He did not name the cartridge.

author: Ilya S.
notes_extra: Nice groups, hard to repeat. 0.010 off. No velocity for 42.5. The 43.0 gr group is a separate row.

author: Ilya S.
notes_extra: Nice groups, hard to repeat. 0.010 off. Same rifle as the 43.5 gr N140 row.

author: XTR
notes_extra: No powder and no charge. 0.015 off the lands. Throated for the 200 Hybrid, which he estimated as about 0.200 to 0.205 freebore. He did not name the cartridge; the thread is the 200.20x.
